label: Joint-prefix contracted cyclic path matrix density - one active next-1s return - lag-0/1/2 production-basis 59-feature state - one recurrent block - W256 - Q16 - D64 - O32 - DQ128 DO256 embedding compression - 256k clean - batch 10240 train and evaluation - shared-step compilation without CUDA Graphs - no dropout - no adversarial inputs or outputs - no auxiliary expectation loss - no SAM - weight EMA 4 epochs - online affine 64k validation

architecture.marketState: m0=GNGLU(concat(feature[t-2:t]),W); the lag-0/1/2 production-basis 59-feature input is unchanged from the controlled H15 run
architecture.pathWeights: the market state emits QD_0 and decodes q_0=P(rho_0)=softmax(row-dot(P_0,QD_0)/sqrt(Q)) from the current embedded paths
architecture.conditionalReturns: T_0=row-softmax(P_0 R_0/sqrt(Q)); J_0=q_0[:,None] times T_0; p_0=sum_D(J_0)
architecture.embeddingCompression: the complete P_0 and J_0 matrices retain the same dense uncapped GNGLU compression as the H15 model; the supervised H1 objective consumes only the first emission
architecture.jointPathContraction: with one active return, the exact forward-contracted joint likelihood is the single conditional density p(r_1|x)
architecture.gradientMemory: the same exact recurrent-step activation-recomputation implementation is retained; H1 contains one unrolled contribution
architecture.matrixApproximation: none; every GNGLU uses dense matrices at expected hidden width floor((input+output)/2)
architecture.outputPoints: ordered market-conditioned unit-interval knots initialized from the fixed global 32-knot grid

density.targetFilter: the lag-0/1/2 input origin and its single following target are chronological exact-nonzero active 1s returns
density.trainingLoss: proper one-step path NLL p(r_1|x), which is exactly the H1 specialization of the forward-contracted joint-path likelihood
